temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices that Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines, saying he has too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated and hardworking friend and doctor, though he had not yet fully registered how unhealthy Gary's work habits had become.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Ethan comes to believe Gary's overwork is serious and that Gary feels unable to step away because of hospital demands.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworking to an unhealthy degree and is resistant to taking a break due to his professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and worried, with some disappointment that Gary declined.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene and persuade Gary to take time for rest and recovery, starting with the weekend retreat.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary's restless behavior and avoidance of discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary's overwork and stress were mainly due to hospital demands, and he hoped the retreat would help Gary relax.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Ethan begins to suspect that Gary's overwork is not solely professional, and Gary's response confirms there is something deeper he has been hiding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dealing with more than ordinary work stress and may have personal problems he has been reluctant to share.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary and encourage him to open up, while offering nonjudgmental support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Gary agrees when Ethan suggests prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had deeper issues beyond work alone, but he did not yet know the specific reasons for Gary's overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Ethan learns that Gary's overwork stems from both new departmental pressures and personal challenges, and that Gary is receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's situation is complex but manageable with support, planning, and better balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief mixed with empathy and compassion.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule to find a healthier balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in with Gary and hears about his progress and remaining challenges. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and having had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had opened up and agreed to work on balance with support, but it was still uncertain how much progress Gary would make.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Ethan sees that Gary is making genuine efforts and real progress, and that his support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving and moving toward a healthier work-life balance, though challenges may remain.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in with Gary and offering encouragement and support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and is capable of managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had been making progress but might still need ongoing support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Ethan's belief shifts from Gary needing active support to Gary being capable of managing independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier balance and can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active intervention while letting Gary know he remains available if needed.
